summary: Master central bank crisis leadership. Learn ELA, macroprudential tools, and resolution planning to ensure financial stability. Expert-led 5-day course.
lede: Leadership in Crisis Management for Central Banks develops the practical capabilities needed to make rapid decisions under uncertainty, manage liquidity, and coordinate responses during systemic shocks. The course focuses on early warning indicators, macroprudential interventions, the Lender of Last Resort function, recovery and resolution planning, and high-pressure stakeholder communications. Through simulated decision-making and framework application, you will practise stress testing, build liquidity assessment dashboards, and draft adaptable intervention protocols. You will also apply the Basel III liquidity coverage ratio and net stable funding ratio in crisis scenarios while addressing political pressure, limited data, cybersecurity threats, and the need to maintain market confidence.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals within central banks and financial regulatory authorities who carry the weight of institutional stability during periods of market distress.
audience: Central Bank Governors and Deputy Governors
modules: Central Bank Mandates and Crisis Foundations
Systemic Risk Identification and Early Warning
Digital Transformation and Future Crisis Risks
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in central banking, financial regulation, or risk management. A foundational understanding of monetary policy and banking supervision is required. Familiarity with the Basel III framework is highly recommended.
